title: UsersDeactivateConfig
description: Authoring-time configuration. `userId` is the chain-parameter fallback (`{{params.userId}}`, frozen at instantiation) — used only when neither an edge-delivered input nor the host-event trigger payload supplies one. Authorization is never configured here: it is the run's acting user holding host:members:manage in the run's tenant.

userId.description: Fallback target account id (`user:<id>`). Runtime inputs win on conflict.
